TypeScript language shortcoming (activesupport/lib/active_support/core_ext/enumerable.rb:199): Rails reaches the series values through `group_by(&key).values_at(*series)`, keying a Ruby Hash by VALUE. `series` holds arbitrary attribute values (Integer, String, nil) and a JS object keys by string coercion, so the port groups into a `Map` seeded from `series` and walks it in series order — same ordering and filter semantics, no `values_at` receiver. The string-keyed `valuesAt` core-ext added for `ids_writer` cannot express it.
